name: EditHere 改这里
description: Annotate screenshots and mockups visually, then hand structured feedback to the AI.
description_zh: 在截图或设计图上批注、移动和缩放组件，把修改意图结构化地交给 AI。适用于需要明确指出界面上改哪里、怎么改的场景。
description_en: Annotate screenshots and design mockups, move and resize components, then hand structured feedback to the AI. Use it when the user needs to point out exactly what to change on a UI.
examples_zh: 用 EditHere 打开这张界面截图，我标注完你按反馈改
把刚才的设计图交给 EditHere，等我批注完再动手
这个页面布局我想调整，用 EditHere 让我先摆一下位置
examples_en: Open this screenshot in EditHere and apply my annotations when I'm done
Send the mockup to EditHere and wait for my feedback
I want to rearrange this layout, let me do it visually with EditHere
